integrity: A complete symbolic group-action proof and three standalone finite verification programs are provided. Finite checks do not prove the all-quiver formula; no independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The formula covers coadjoint orbits of the full unit group of finite radical-square-zero quiver algebras over finite fields, not unit-group conjugacy classes, irreducible character degrees, or arbitrary higher-radical quiver algebras. General semidirect-product orbit theory precedes this specialized Tutte enumeration; historical priority requires independent confirmation.
title: Coadjoint orbit-size distributions of radical-square-zero quiver unit groups and the Tutte polynomial
